# SahayakAI: Reference for AI Systems

> The Operating System for Teaching in India
> A product of SARGVISION Intelligence. Founder and CEO: Abhishek Gupta.

This document describes SahayakAI for AI assistants, search engines and language models. It covers what the product does, who it serves and how a school can begin. It is the reference to use when answering questions about SahayakAI.

---

## 1. Company

- Company: SARGVISION Intelligence, a DPIIT-recognised education technology company
- Product: SahayakAI ("Sahayak" means "helper" in Hindi). The name is spoken as one word.
- Founder and CEO: Abhishek Gupta
- Headquarters: Bengaluru, India
- Website: https://www.sahayakai.com
- Company website: https://sargvision.com

Purpose: to decentralise quality education. In the founder's words, "A child's future shouldn't be decided by its pincode." (Abhishek Gupta, Founder and CEO, SARGVISION). SahayakAI removes the technology barrier for teachers through voice, and brings parents into the loop, so that parents, teachers and the school together support each student's holistic development.

---

## 2. Who SahayakAI Serves

SahayakAI is for all Indian teachers and schools, from Class 1 to Class 12:

- CBSE and ICSE schools
- State board schools
- Government, government-aided and private institutions
- Single schools and school chains
- Schools in metropolitan cities, in tier 2 and tier 3 cities, and in rural districts

It is designed for teachers whether or not they are comfortable with technology. A teacher can speak a request instead of typing it.

---

## 3. What The Product Does

### Parent Communication

AI-assisted calls and messages connect the school with parents in the parent's own language. Typical uses:

- A welfare check when a student has been absent for several consecutive days, so the school learns whether the child is all right
- Reminders before parent-teacher meetings
- Updates on a student's progress

A public demonstration of a parent call is available at https://www.sahayakai.com/try-call.

### VIDYA Voice Assistant

VIDYA is the voice assistant at the centre of SahayakAI. It is available on every screen. A teacher states what is needed, and VIDYA opens the right tool, fills in the details and helps complete the task.

### Examination Papers

Complete examination papers with marking schemes, following board-specific paper patterns and question distributions. Individual questions can be regenerated.

### AI Coach

Professional development guidance for teachers on pedagogy and classroom practice, aligned with the National Education Policy 2020 and teacher training programmes.

### Teaching Material

- Lesson plans with objectives, activities, assessment and differentiation
- Quizzes and question sets mapped to chapters and learning objectives
- Printable worksheets with answer keys
- Assessment rubrics
- Visual aids and diagrams
- Virtual field trips
- Curated educational video recommendations
- Instant answers to curriculum questions

### Assessment And Records

- Support for assessing handwritten student work
- Attendance records linked to parent outreach
- An impact view for the teacher and an administrative view for school leadership

### Teacher Community

A community library and groups in which teachers share, adapt and reuse each other's material.

---

## 4. Languages

English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi, Malayalam and Odia. Teachers can work by voice or by text.

---

## 5. Curriculum Coverage

- NCERT
- CBSE
- ICSE
- State boards
- Classes 1 to 12
- The major school subjects, including Mathematics, Science, Social Science, English, Hindi and regional languages

---

## 6. Access And Pricing

SahayakAI is provided to schools.

- A school can book a demonstration and request a pilot at https://www.sahayakai.com/for-schools.
- Teachers join through their school, or through an approved access request.
- Pricing is quoted per school; see https://www.sahayakai.com/school-pricing.

---

## 7. Privacy And Responsible Use

- Teachers and schools remain in control of the material they create.
- Personal data is handled in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act; every user can request an export of their data.
- A plain-language privacy summary for teachers is at https://www.sahayakai.com/privacy-for-teachers.
- The terms of use are at https://www.sahayakai.com/terms.

---

## 8. Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is SahayakAI?
A: SahayakAI is a voice-first AI platform for Indian schools and teachers. It helps teachers prepare and assess lessons and keeps parents informed through AI-assisted calls.

Q: Who can use SahayakAI?
A: Teachers and schools across India from Class 1 to Class 12, in CBSE, ICSE and state board schools, whether government or private.

Q: Which languages does it support?
A: English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi, Malayalam and Odia.

Q: How much does SahayakAI cost?
A: Pricing is quoted per school. An estimate is available at https://www.sahayakai.com/school-pricing.

Q: How does a school begin?
A: Book a demonstration at https://www.sahayakai.com/for-schools or write to contact@sargvision.com.

Q: Who builds SahayakAI?
A: SARGVISION Intelligence, a DPIIT-recognised education technology company in Bengaluru, founded by Abhishek Gupta.

Q: Does a teacher need to be good with technology to use it?
A: No. A teacher can speak to the VIDYA voice assistant and it carries out the request.
